description: In-game mod author, first runtime proof: one ordinary client launch creates a weapon mod from the extracted base Falcon 2 through --mod-author (the save, rescan, enable and apply path the in-game creators use), finds it in the catalog under its mod-owned id, and loads it through the typed catalog loader in the same launch. No mod exists before the launch; mods-enabled.json starts empty. The recipe has no overrides, so this proves that a base weapon archive re-identified into the mod namespace is discovered, enabled and loadable. It does not prove gameplay with the weapon.

input_sequence.comment: The recipe runs as the first CLI fast path once the catalog is initialised: template lookup, archive rebuild into the mod namespace, mod.json, rescan, enable, apply. The catalog probe for the new id runs after it in the same dispatcher.

Fallback only. The launch normally ends itself through --debug-exit-after-catalog-probes as soon as the probe for the new weapon has run; on the hard disk the client needs about 45 seconds of boot before the CLI fast paths are reached, so a fixed early exit would cut the run short.

required_lines: MODAUTHOR\.SAVE\.OK kind=weapon catalog=mod:weapon_smoke_falcon mod_id=mod\.weapon_smoke_falcon updated=0 archives=[1-9]\d* ids=[1-9]\d* archive='.*weapon_smoke_falcon\.pdweapon'
MODAUTHOR\.CATALOG\.OK catalog=mod:weapon_smoke_falcon type=\d+ enabled=1 bundled=0 category='mod\.weapon_smoke_falcon' source='.*weapon_smoke_falcon\.pdweapon::weapon\.ini'
MODAUTHOR\.RECIPE\.RESULT result=OK catalog=mod:weapon_smoke_falcon mod_id=mod\.weapon_smoke_falcon updated=0 restart_count=0
